nl.bodyHtml:
Op WordPress doe je zelf de basis; TripleZero iT helpt met traject, techniek en AEO/GEO/SEO-diepte. Eén SEO-plugin is genoeg — niet drie.

Zelf

  • Titles/meta’s invullen.
  • Goede permalinks en interne links.
  • Images met alt waar zinvol.
  • Updates/backups (of via hostingafspraken).

TripleZero iT

  • Technische audit en indexatie.
  • Content/AEO-structuur en lokale pagina’s.
  • Pakkettraject basic/plus/pro of losse SEO-dienst.

Let op: Conflicterende SEO-plugins veroorzaken dubbele schema’s en meta-chaos.

Heb je na het volgen van deze stappen nog vragen? Neem contact op met TripleZero iT support via het ticketssysteem of plan een afspraak. Vermeld je domein, doelen (AEO, GEO en/of SEO) en eventuele AI-scanresultaten.

Gerelateerd: Webshop-SEO; losse SEO naast pakket.

en.title: SEO for WordPress: what doe your zelf and what doet TripleZero iT?
en.excerpt: SEO for WordPress: what doe your zelf and what doet TripleZero iT: backup, wp-admin, clear cache, verify.
en.bodyHtml:
For “SEO for WordPress: what doe your zelf and what doet TripleZero iT” you work in WordPress (/wp-admin) on TripleZero iT hosting. Take a backup first; then change carefully and clear caches.

Preparation

  • Installatron or panel backup (files + database)
  • Login to /wp-admin of the correct site
  • DirectAdmin File Manager if wp-admin will not open

Steps

  1. Create a backup via Installatron or DirectAdmin.
  2. Sign in to /wp-admin.
  3. Apply the change in the correct menu: Plugins, Themes, Settings, Users, Media or WooCommerce.
  4. Save. On a critical error: via File Manager temporarily rename wp-content/plugins or activate a default theme.
  5. Clear page cache, object cache and CDN cache.
  6. Test the homepage, login and a critical flow (form or checkout).

Verify

  • No critical error
  • Change visible on the front end or in wp-admin

Tip: Change one plugin or theme at a time — faster rollback.

Note: Do not delete the uploads folder or database tables without a restore plan.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: Installatron backup, PHP version, critical error.
